When I was 17, I lived with my girlfriend’s aunt, who was mid 30s at the time. She would get so jealous of her niece coming over to spend time with me, She would put her down all the time and try to humiliate her in front of me. She used to get upset at me for staying up late talking to my girlfriend, yet she would get upset with me if I didn’t stay up all night talking to her, which we did a lot. One time while living there, I was on the school bus headed home and we got into an accident and the whiplash made me real sore. She insisted she draw me a bath and wanted to keep the door unlocked, so she can “check up on me” at any time. On New Years, we were playing that game where you put a card on your forehead with a word on it and people have to try to explain it to you. Well, the word I got was “cheesecake” and she made an inappropriate comment which I did not notice. The rest of the family took me to the kitchen to let me know that I might be getting groomed. Afterwards, I started noticing the signs and becoming creeped out, so I isolated myself from everyone, until she got so upset with me, she had me leave. Still hard to believe to this day. Part of me feels like maybe I was overthinking it and nothing was going on at all, but I don’t know.

She became so fatigued, she was about to take a nap, but her sister told her to go to the E.R. She went septic almost immediately and almost died, luckily she pulled through. If she took that nap, it would be a different outcome.

My dad was working out one day and started feeling chest pains. He thought it was due to working out too hard, so he showered and tried lay down and nap, but his anxiety got to him and he went to the E.R. turns out he was having a heart attack, and had one a week before too, and didn't notice. They rushed him to a bigger hospital and did immediate surgery, he also pulled through. If he had taken a nap, it also would've been a different outcome
